title: Planet Labs PBC Q1 fiscal 2027 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At April 30, Planet had USD 368.1 million cash, USD 362.7 million short-term investments, USD 460 million face value of 2030 notes, 356.4 million issued shares, and 27.6 million unvested RSUs.
summary: The Form 10-Q confirms instrument identity, revenue and retention, RPO quality, liquidity, convertible-note and dilution exposure, stock compensation, capital intensity, government-contract cancellation risk, and the inputs used in the bounded valuation.
